scope_support.exclusion_quote: Training Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with two teachers on diverse, curated tool-use tasks yields average gains of 3.3-6.9 percentage points across four out-of-distribution benchmarks.
scope_support.feedback_quote: At each such state, ActionOPD samples actions from both the student and a black-box teacher, rewarding student actions according to their semantic agreement with the sampled teacher actions.
scope_support.object_quote: Through policy optimization, ActionOPD aligns the student's action-level behavior with the teacher's decisions
